title: Family Gathering Under Patio Umbrella, 1960 Backyard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid snapshot capturing a family gathered on a suburban concrete patio beneath a large fringed umbrella adorned with balloons. A little toddler girl in a white ruffled dress stands near the metal lawn table while adults relax and converse. A wooden fence and suburban roofline are visible in the background, reflecting post-war American suburban backyard lifestyle in May 1960.
